label: The cross-phase conflict list: fourteen conflicts, each with the two documents, the disagreement and the resolution; three are P0 (SCHEMA_VERSION, operators.json, until), eight P1 and three P2

Three of the fourteen conflicts cannot be fixed by a spec edit and need an owner decision: who owns operators.json, whether a routine carries a command at all, and whether a two-person shared host is in scope (P0)

Five of the fourteen are one shared record with three or more writers (ITEM_KEYS 3, FRONTMATTER_KEYS 5, state-root 6, HonoredPosture 3, the actor name 3), which is an accumulation rather than a disagreement and needs one target list in the parent (P1)

Two of the fourteen are an output-to-input mismatch where the consumer declares the dependency and the shapes still disagree (010 to 011 messages, 001 to 003 status), and these fail at the first integration run rather than at review (P1)

Two of the fourteen live outside the packet, in the deep-loop's assertDispatchEnvAllowed and in the .opencode bots.cjs mirror, and both fail silently: a widened filter still works and a drifted mirror still runs (P1)

One pair that looks like a conflict is not: 003 consumes 002's bots routines --json unchanged and waits for 001's inbox --json, declared on both sides, and it is the packet's only producer-consumer pair written to agree (P2)
